headline: 超级英雄霸榜，今日无新片
headlineEn: Superheroes dominate charts, no new releases today
summary: 今日无新片上映，本周仅3部新片。超级英雄与经典IP续作霸榜，《绿灯军团》《奥德赛》领跑热议，市场静待下一波大片。
summaryEn: No new movies today, only 3 this week. Superhero and classic IP sequels dominate trending, with Green Lantern Corps and The Odyssey leading buzz as the market awaits the next wave.

industryHighlights.text: 超级英雄IP占据热搜半壁江山
industryHighlights.en: Superhero IPs dominate the trending list
The Odyssey is one of the top trending topics

industryHighlights.text: 后续档期暂无重磅新片公布
